witness.description: Describe the exact physical/digital witness used

languages.label: Historical language as documented by the source
languages.code_note: Do not assign a modern variety code unless the source itself or reproducible external evidence justifies that mapping.

source_specific_graphemic_features.normalization_warning: Retrieval normalization must never silently imply phonological identity, cognacy, semantic identity or historical continuity.

validation.rule: No automatic result may be relabeled as human_verified or expert_verified. Unresolved machine states are legitimate terminal scholarly outputs when evidence is insufficient.

documentary_body_complete_when: all candidate boundaries have explicit machine disposition
all active textual units have an AI-assisted documentary transcription or an explicit unresolved state
all detected uncertainties have explicit terminal machine state
machine_only_scholarly_edition_complete_: all declared documentary and appendix units are represented non-destructively
all detected uncertainty remains explicit rather than silently repaired
chosen TEI or other interoperability exports validate against their declared profiles
industrialization_demonstrated_when: a second real source completes the same core pipeline
source-specific differences remain in the source profile whenever possible
no fundamental redesign of the RHD core is required
